title: Exchange transport has no active back-pressure meters
description: Live EdgeTransport ResourceThrottling diagnostics SHOULD NOT report resource meters in a non-Low state, except for SystemMemory, which does not block mail flow. Missing, failed, or malformed diagnostic data is Unknown.
subject: Server

references.name: Back pressure and resource monitoring in Exchange Server

remediation.description: Review the active resource meters and corresponding Exchange transport, disk, or memory health before taking action. Do not change back-pressure thresholds solely to clear this finding.

considerations: This live diagnostic check is distinct from EDCA-MON-009, which evaluates EdgeTransport.exe.config. Medium or High non-SystemMemory meters are Fail; SystemMemory is excluded. Empty, unexpected, malformed, or inaccessible diagnostic data is Unknown.
